analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating in the low 40s, showing weak signs of exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving but remains in negative territory. While the current price is up 6.27% against SMA200, it is entering resistance zones around short-term moving averages like SMA20 and EMA50. Considering the ATR of 5.74%, premature entry carries risk.
